training.method: Depth-four teacher distillation against standard Alpha-Beta, relabelled recorded maze, horizontal and rotated/player-swapped augmentation, policy/value and distance-auxiliary losses.

hyperparameters.selection: held-out policy CE + value MSE; validation states overlapping training removed

interpretation: Fixed small opening suite; changes include both trained weights and PUCT guidance/parameters. Three observed wins establish ability to beat standard Alpha-Beta, not a general 25% win-rate estimate.
